newsitem.title: USA: Hydron sees record sales, "satisfactory" profits.
newsitem.headline: Hydron sees record sales, "satisfactory" profits.

text.p: Hydron Technologies Inc said Monday it expects a record second quarter in sales, and a "satisfactory" profit for the second quarter despite heavy expenses as it expands its direct marketing business.
The company said that based on current orders in house and expected orders, second quarter sales will be a substantial increase over the $2 million in sales recorded in the second quarter of 1996.
The company said sales to consumers this year are about 40 percent ahead of last year.
